GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-08-04T04:37:39Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Can't define variable using type of typeof
Description: I declared `test` module to export the global mongoose variable as below.
test1.d.ts:

``` javascript
  declare module "test" {
    import _mongoose = require('mongoose');
    export var export_mongoose: typeof _mongoose;
  }
```

I tried to define mongoose.Model using the export_mongoose variable. Please refer to below code:
test2.ts:

``` javascript
  /// \<reference path="test1.d.ts" /\>
  import test = require('test');
  var model: test.export_mongoose.Model\<number\>;  // it doesn't work.
  var model = test.export_mongoose;  // it works well.
```

However, tsc compiler shows a following error message:
  TS2305: Module `test` has no exported member `export_mongoose`.

I think the export_mongoose is not proper as type cause defined by `typeof`.
Can I use the `export_mongoose` as type?

It would be helpful for me if you have any idea on this.
